Planets.CatText: Planets of Tau Ceti. The planets listed here are unconfirmed candidates detected by radial velocity (Feng et al. 2017); their masses are minimum masses.

TauCetig.Text: Tau Ceti g is a candidate planet of at least about 1.75 Earth masses with a 20-day orbit.

TauCetih.Text: Tau Ceti h is a candidate planet of at least about 1.83 Earth masses with a 49-day orbit.

TauCetif.Text: Tau Ceti f is a candidate super-Earth of at least about 3.9 Earth masses with a 636-day orbit, near the outer edge of Tau Ceti's habitable zone.
